source_motivation: arXiv 2602.24286 (CUDA-Agent, ByteDance Seed/Tsinghua): agentic-RL CUDA kernel writer. RL legs rejected (128-GPU pool, no local training). Adopted: environment/eval protocol (milestone reward -1/+1/+2/+3, anti-reward-hacking), training-free agent loop with the session model as drafting agent.

traps_found: zcode AppImage shadows python3.14 in PATH -> venv python symlinked to the desktop app; fixed by absolute-path venv + env -i everywhere (docs/gfx1100-notes.md §1)
tool-shell PYTHONPATH leak (~/.local + projects/sinter) preempts venv site-packages; pip silently no-ops claiming 'torch already satisfied' (2.14.0+cpu user-site)

torch cpp_extension emits -isystem /usr/include on the HIP branch (CUDA branch HAS the guard, HIP branch doesn't) -> all #include_next <stdlib.h>/<math.h> fail on host AND device passes; fixed by monkeypatching include_paths (harness/eval_protected.py::_patched_load_inline); minimal repro verified
Fedora hipcc default = 13-arch fat binaries; PYTORCH_ROCM_ARCH=gfx1100 pins it (read at call time)
extension cache (torch_extensions/py314_cpu/<name>) replays stale build.ninja after env changes; rm -rf needed
fp64 upcast in digests (t.sum(dtype=float64)) allocs 12 GiB on 1.6G-elem tensors -> OOM; chunked fp32 digests now
paranoia item: zcode desktop-hook noise pollutes stdout AND redirected fds; workloads write their own JSON, stdout never trusted
